verdict.rationale: PostHog documents an official MCP server enabling agents to run trends/funnels/retention/SQL queries, ship feature flags, and build/assemble dashboards from plain-text prompts (posthog-docs-2, posthog-docs-3, posthog-docs-19, posthog-docs-24, posthog-docs-30), backed by a public OpenAPI spec (posthog-probe-3) and dedicated MCP docs (posthog-probe-4). This directly supports an agent building a dashboard of key metrics end-to-end via API or MCP. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that an agent can autonomously assemble a full dashboard (not just individual insights) via MCP, and no third-party case study confirming end-to-end success.
